string.text: Generate images automatically
Active only when image generation is enabled. When on, illustrations are generated during bulletin creation; when off, they are generated when the panel opens and the cache misses.
Redraw scene illustration after NPC replies

After the player generates the first illustration, each NPC reply redraws one automatically. Later requests reuse the initial panorama, references, and stable facts while updating the latest two dialogue turns and actions.
Maximum local cache images
Maximum number of generated images kept in the persistent local cache to avoid duplicate requests.
Clean temporary files after generation

Each extraction task cleans only its own off-screen exports when it finishes. When disabled, heraldry exports are kept for troubleshooting; loaded portrait files still follow the normal release flow. Gallery caches and default illustrations are unaffected.
Custom director prompt

Set composition, action, shot, and narrative preferences for encyclopedia, meetings, and bulletins. Blank keeps defaults. Sent only to the Visual Director and cannot override known facts or output format.
Custom style prompt (active when Style=prompt)
Open the long-text editor to edit style instructions. Active only when the style preset is “prompt”; injected into every image channel. A classical oil-painting preset is provided as a reference.
Director maximum output tokens
max_tokens sent to the director API, default 25000. This is an output budget, not a target length; configure it within the API limits.
Director prompt reference length (approx. tokens)

A soft length reference, not the API output limit. When forced reduction is enabled, the character budget takes priority; otherwise the complete reply may contain at most 30000 characters. The full four sections are retained without padding.
AnimusForge - AI Illustrator
Illustration display mode

Standalone panel uses the scene illustration panel. Fullscreen overlay fills the conversation background while preserving controls and input. It hides automatically for encyclopedia and menus. Automatic redraw uses this choice.
Enable image generation
Master switch for all image-generation paths. When disabled, encyclopedia, conversation, bulletin, and gallery entries will not send image requests.
Fetch image model list

Queries the configured endpoint for models. Google native mode uses /models and native authentication. Only the current response page is read; enter a model manually if it is not listed. Image and art models are prioritized.
Preserve AF equipment

Preserves equipment identity while allowing narrative changes such as tears, stains, or wetness. When disabled, clothing, armor, weapons, and accessories follow custom director rules; identity and established facts remain. Affects new requests only and never changes game equipment.

Image API endpoint (Base URL)

For compatible APIs, enter the service root or /v1. Google native APIs accept the v1beta root or a complete /models/name:generateContent URL. Player2 is detected automatically at http://127.0.0.1:4315 and chooses its model in the Player2 app. With a reference image, /images/edits is preferred; without one, /images/generations is used. The model must support the selected channel.
Image API key (API Key)
API key for authentication. Leave blank for endpoints that need no authentication or local proxies.
Image model name (Model)
Image model name. Supports standard image models and native multimodal conversation image models; the channel is detected automatically.
Image resolution (Size)

Bulletin and fullscreen scene illustrations convert presets to 16:9: the 1024 square and 1280/720 presets become 1280×720; the 1344/1536 presets become 1536×864; the 2048 square becomes 2048×1152. Encyclopedia and standalone-panel scene illustrations use the selected size. The image service must support the corresponding size.
Image request timeout

Maximum total wait for one image request; the default is 240 seconds. Includes Edits attempts, conversation-channel fallback, and downloading the result image. Increase it for high-quality redraws with multiple reference images or a slow relay. Applies to the next image request and does not affect visual director requests or off-screen capture timeouts.
Negative prompt (Negative Prompt)
Open the long-text editor and list elements to exclude from the image. Active only for the custom prompt style; appended after preset negative terms.
Enable off-screen scene rendering (environment panorama)

When enabled, conversation illustrations render a panorama within 30 meters of the player in the background for buildings, furnishings, and materials. Capture takes a few seconds and uses some GPU. When disabled, the environment uses the current screenshot and textual facts. Character portraits always render off-screen. World-map conversations do not use panoramas.
Open editor
Panorama direction export timeout
Maximum wait for each panorama direction PNG, default 6 seconds. Six directions are captured sequentially and remain subject to the total timeout.
Environment panorama total timeout
Total budget for stage extraction, environment copy construction, and six-direction capture, default 40 seconds. Stops when the budget is reached and does not send missing or duplicate images.
Character portrait export timeout
Maximum wait for each off-screen portrait, default 20 seconds. Applies to the next extraction and does not affect AI API timeouts.
Image quality preset (Quality)

standard/hd target DALL-E-3; low/medium/high/auto target gpt-image-1 and compatible proxies. Default omits the parameter to avoid unsupported-model errors. Conversation image channels convert this to a quality prompt.

At 0, no random prompt is added. Higher values encourage variation in framing, negative space, depth of field, and lighting while preserving identity, equipment, heraldry, and established facts. This controls prompt guidance, not model sampling.
Send reference image to image model
Sends captured 3D character references with the request through supported multimodal and image-edit channels. When disabled, references are used only by the prompt director.
Select image model (dropdown)
After fetching models above, select one here. Choosing “*manual input*” uses the model name entered above.
Generation style (Style)

vivid/natural are official OpenAI style enums. Other presets inject style instructions and negative terms into the prompt instead of sending a style parameter. Choosing “prompt” uses the custom text below.
Test image API (may incur charges)

Generates one test image with the current configuration and may incur service charges. Sends one request without channel retries. Click again to cancel while running. No save or game capture is needed; the result is saved under Cache/Illustrator/ApiTest/last-result.png.

Edit custom director prompt

For the Visual Director only: controls composition, action, shot size, and narrative without overriding actual people, equipment, events, or the four-section output format. Inactive when the director is disabled or unconfigured.
For example: prioritize interaction between characters over static front-facing poses; choose a moment that explains the current event. Leave blank to restore default rules.
